title: First Aid certification renewal
plainDescription: Clinical staff must renew their First Aid certificate so it never lapses.

source.quote: Clinical staff must hold a current First Aid certificate.

title: AML training renewal
plainDescription: Treasury staff complete anti-money-laundering training once a year.

source.quote: Treasury staff must complete AML training annually.

title: Security awareness training renewal
plainDescription: Every member of staff refreshes security awareness training yearly.

source.quote: All staff must complete security awareness training each year.

title: No work on an expired certification
plainDescription: Someone whose required certificate is missing or expired stops the work that depends on it.

source.quote: A person whose required certificate is missing or expired may not perform the tasks that depend on it until a valid certificate is on file.

title: Monthly expiry report to managers
plainDescription: Managers receive a report of upcoming certificate expiry dates every month.

source.quote: Certification expiry dates must be reported to managers each month.

title: Renew certificates 30 days ahead
plainDescription: Staff start renewing a certificate at least 30 days before it expires.

source.quote: Staff must renew each certificate at least 30 days before it expires.

title: Training records kept three years
plainDescription: Training records stay on file for three years after someone leaves.

source.quote: Training records must be kept for three years after a person leaves the firm.

title: Critical vendor documents
plainDescription: Critical-tier vendors file a current SOC 2 report, a data processing agreement and insurance proof.

source.quote: Critical-tier vendors must provide a current SOC 2 report, a signed data processing agreement and proof of insurance.

title: Standard vendor documents
plainDescription: Standard-tier vendors file a signed data processing agreement.

source.quote: Standard-tier vendors must provide a signed data processing agreement.

title: Vendor insurance renewal
plainDescription: Insurance certificates are renewed yearly and the evidence is filed.

source.quote: Insurance certificates must be renewed annually and the renewal evidence must be filed with the vendor record.

title: Vendor DPA renewal
plainDescription: Data processing agreements are renewed before they expire.

source.quote: Data processing agreements must be renewed before they expire.

title: Annual vendor review
plainDescription: Each vendor's owner reviews it at least once a year and records the date.

source.quote: Each vendor must be reviewed at least annually by its named owner, and the review date must be recorded on the vendor record.

title: Quarterly vendor risk ratings
plainDescription: Vendor risk ratings are refreshed every quarter.

source.quote: Vendor risk ratings must be refreshed each quarter.

title: Vendor offboarding within 30 days of contract end
plainDescription: Remove a vendor's access and data within 30 days of the contract ending.

source.quote: Vendor access must be revoked within 30 days of contract termination.

title: Contract before work starts
plainDescription: A signed contract is in place before any vendor begins work.

source.quote: A signed contract must be in place before any vendor starts work.

title: One approver from USD 5,000
plainDescription: Payments of USD 5,000 or more need one approver who is not the requester.

source.quote: Payments of USD 5,000 or more require one approver who did not request the payment.

title: Two approvers from USD 25,000
plainDescription: Payments of USD 25,000 or more need two different approvers.

source.quote: Payments of USD 25,000 or more require two distinct approvers.

title: Treasury sign-off above USD 50,000
plainDescription: Wire transfers above USD 50,000 also need the treasury manager.

source.quote: Wire transfers above USD 50,000 require approval by the treasury manager in addition to the two distinct approvers.

title: No self-approval
plainDescription: The person who requested a payment can never approve it.

source.quote: The requester may never approve their own payment.

title: Approvals must be distinct
plainDescription: Two approvals from one person only count once.

source.quote: Two approvals from the same person count as one.

title: Quarterly review of payment exceptions
plainDescription: Payment policy exceptions are logged and reviewed every quarter.

source.quote: Payment policy exceptions must be logged and reviewed each quarter.

title: Approval evidence retained
plainDescription: Approval evidence stays filed with each payment record.

source.quote: The approval evidence for each payment must be retained with the payment record.

title: Monthly reconciliation outside payments
plainDescription: Balances are reconciled monthly by someone outside the payments team.

source.quote: Balances must be reconciled monthly by someone outside the payments team.

title: Quarterly suspicious activity filing
plainDescription: File the quarterly suspicious activity summary with the designated regulator.

source.quote: A suspicious activity summary must be filed within fifteen days of each quarter end.

title: Suspicious activity report within 30 days
plainDescription: A suspicious activity report goes out within 30 days of detecting the facts.

source.quote: A suspicious activity report must be filed within 30 calendar days of initial detection of the facts that support it.

title: Currency transaction report within 15 days
plainDescription: Currency transaction reports are filed within 15 days of the transaction.

source.quote: Currency transaction reports must be filed within 15 days of the reportable transaction.

title: Quarterly tax filing
plainDescription: Quarterly tax filings go in at the end of April, July, October and January.

source.quote: Quarterly tax filings are due at the end of April, July, October and January.

title: Annual board summary
plainDescription: The board receives the annual summary of filed reports each January.

source.quote: The annual summary of filed reports must be delivered to the board each January.

title: Operating licence renewal
plainDescription: The operating licence is renewed every two years, submitted 60 days early.

source.quote: Our operating licence must be renewed every two years, and the renewal must be submitted at least 60 days before it expires.

title: Monthly horizon scanning
plainDescription: The compliance team reviews regulatory changes every month.

source.quote: Regulatory changes must be reviewed monthly by the compliance team.

title: Separate code changes from deploys
plainDescription: Nobody both changes production code and deploys it without a second person approving.

source.quote: No one person may both change production code and deploy it to production without a second person approving the deploy.

title: Restricted records limited to the care team
plainDescription: Restricted patient records are only viewed by the care team.

source.quote: Restricted patient records may only be viewed by members of the care team.

title: Ask only for the records needed
plainDescription: Staff request only the records the task in front of them needs.

source.quote: Staff must ask only for the records they need for the task in front of them.

title: Multi-factor on privileged accounts
plainDescription: Every privileged account has multi-factor authentication switched on.

source.quote: Every privileged account must have multi-factor authentication enabled.

title: Access review each January
plainDescription: Review every system access list each January.

source.quote: Access reviews must be completed every January.

title: Access removed within one business day
plainDescription: A leaving person's access is removed within one business day.

source.quote: Access must be removed within one business day of a person leaving the firm.

title: Report structuring patterns
plainDescription: Deposits that stay just under the limit are reviewed and reported when they form a pattern.

source.quote: Cash deposits that stay just under the reporting limit must be reviewed and reported when they form a pattern.

title: Daily review of the band
plainDescription: Cash activity just under the limit is reviewed every working day.

source.quote: Cash activity inside the just-under-limit band must be reviewed every working day.

title: Escalate split payments
plainDescription: Any attempt to split a payment around a threshold is escalated.

source.quote: Staff must escalate any attempt to split a payment to avoid a reporting threshold.

title: Annual review of the AML procedure
plainDescription: The AML procedure gets an independent review each February.

source.quote: The annual independent review of this procedure must be completed each February.

title: Identify customers before opening
plainDescription: Customers are identified before an account is opened.

source.quote: Customers must be identified before an account is opened.

title: Never disclose a report to its subject
plainDescription: The subject of a suspicious activity report is never told about it.

source.quote: A suspicious activity report must never be disclosed to the subject of the report.

title: No secrets in the repository
plainDescription: Secrets and credentials are never committed to the repository.

source.quote: Secrets and credentials must never be committed to the repository.

title: Secret scan before the main branch
plainDescription: Commits are scanned for hardcoded secrets before they reach the main branch.

source.quote: Commits must be scanned for hardcoded secrets before they reach the main branch.

title: Annual penetration test
plainDescription: Commission an independent penetration test of customer-facing systems once a year.

source.quote: Customer-facing systems must undergo an independent penetration test at least annually.

title: Weekly dependency scan
plainDescription: Dependencies are scanned for known vulnerabilities every week.

source.quote: Dependencies must be scanned for known vulnerabilities every week.

title: Disaster recovery test each June
plainDescription: Disaster recovery tests run each June and the results are filed.

source.quote: Disaster recovery tests must be run each June and the results must be filed.

title: Second engineer reviews every change
plainDescription: A second engineer reviews every change to production code.

source.quote: All changes to production code must be reviewed by a second engineer.

title: Receipt for USD 75 or more
plainDescription: Expenses of USD 75 or more come with a receipt.

source.quote: Expenses of USD 75 or more must be supported by a receipt.

title: Claims within 30 days
plainDescription: Expense claims are submitted within 30 days of the spend.

source.quote: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the spend.

title: Manager approves before reimbursement
plainDescription: A manager approves every expense claim before money goes out.

source.quote: A manager must approve every expense claim before reimbursement.

title: Close expense reports by the 10th
plainDescription: The previous month's expense reports are closed by the 10th.

source.quote: Expense reports for the previous month must be closed by the 10th.

title: Expense policy acknowledgement each January
plainDescription: Everyone acknowledges the expense policy each January.

source.quote: Every member of staff must acknowledge the expense policy each January.

title: Mileage needs a logged journey
plainDescription: Mileage claims come with a logged journey.

source.quote: Mileage is paid at the standard rate and requires a logged journey.
